versions.changelog:
Initial release of Meituan RMS Open Platform API fetcher.

- Provides detailed documentation of 329 APIs across 6 categories.
- Includes full solution docs for 12 business scenarios.
- Features cross-category data analysis and message push documentation.
- Supplies organized data files for APIs, solutions, scripts, and reports.
- Offers command-line usage for statistics, API search, and solution browsing.
